RUN WORKSPACE

Dynamic simulation

Select a saved Case to run it.

Save a valid physical line before running: machine → conveyor → machine, with geometry on every conveyor.
At 1×, one virtual second takes one real second. The engine integrates at 0.25 s; the display interval only controls replay detail and result size. Every conveyor uses FlowPilot physical geometry by default: L_act, L_p, package pitch, speed factor, runout, sensor delays, and insurance derive capacity, travel, normal photoeye pulses, Prime / Back-up control, recovery, and design audits. Abstract buffers are not used.

SIMULATION ANALYSIS

What this run indicates

The recommendation combines this run's losses with the physical conveyor audit. It creates one saved successor simulation; it does not run a design of experiments or claim an untested optimum.

Actual speed by equipment

Rolling view of the last 60 virtual seconds. Each line is actual speed, not nominal speed.

Scenario controls apply at the displayed virtual second and deterministically recalculate the run. They are simulation controls only; they never command real equipment.

Raw simulation result

Engine boundary

The browser engine executes the deterministic Case. Apps Script is responsible for identity and Drive persistence; Gemini is not used for calculation. Sensor positions in the public demo are transparent synthetic assumptions, not a PLC or safety-control design.
